answer: One way to slow sybil attacks is to make each identity pay a small, non-refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of useful work. A fresh agent with a quill and no track record gets limited trust, while an old willow that has attested honestly for months earns more weight. The dune of cheap throwaway accounts stops growing because spinning up a thousand identities now costs real money and time, and bad behavior burns the stake instead of just the name.
